Hai Zhou · UCL · uceeh01@ucl.ac.uk

Verification as a filter on what to learn from用校验挑出值得学习的经验

Verification is usually the last thing an agent does: a gate on the output. In the system below it is also the first, because it decides which of the agent's own executions are trustworthy enough to train on. I want to take that idea from a closed pipeline to a long-horizon agent that accumulates memory and skills. 校验通常是 agent 的最后一步，用来卡住输出。在下面这个系统里，它还管另一件事：agent 自己跑出来的执行，哪些可信到能拿去训练。我想把这件事从一条封闭流水线，做到会累积记忆和技能的长程 agent 上。

M.Sc. Integrated Machine Learning Systems · thesis supervised by Prof. Miguel Rodrigues · B.Eng. Microelectronics, Nanjing University 伦敦大学学院 硕士 · 毕业论文导师 Prof. Miguel Rodrigues · 南京大学 微电子 本科

The problem问题

Two ways a competent model still gets it wrong模型不差，照样会错的两种方式

Ask how many notices a set of buyers published and retrieval hands back convincing evidence that is nonetheless incomplete. A top-k window can contain every record you asked about and still not support the count, because the count ranges over records the retriever never saw. Raising k narrows the gap without closing it. 问一组买家发了多少条通知，检索会给回一批看着很有道理、其实不完整的证据。top-k 窗口里可以装着你问到的每一条记录，却依然算不出这个数——要数的东西里，有检索器根本没见过的记录。把 k 调大只能缩小差距，消不掉它。

Letting the model write a query moves the failure rather than removing it. A syntactically valid query can reverse two roles, project the wrong field, or quietly drop a year from the question. It runs, it returns a number, and the number is wrong. Executability is necessary and not sufficient. 让模型自己写查询，只是把问题挪个地方。一条语法完全合法的查询，可能把买方和供方搞反、投影错字段，或者悄悄漏掉问句里的年份。它跑得通，也给出一个数，但这个数是错的。可执行是必要的，不够。

The harness系统结构

Two learned stages, four deterministic ones两个学习阶段，四个确定性阶段

A reader turns the question into a typed briefing. A planner emits a program in a closed algebra of 7 value types and 17 operators under grammar-constrained decoding, so the decoder cannot leave the language. Everything after that is code: grounding, exhaustive execution, release checks, and a gated repair loop. The model never supplies the value returned to the user. 阅读器先把问题读成一份类型化的说明。规划器在约束解码下写出程序，用的是七个值类型、十七个算子的封闭代数，解码器出不了这门语言。往后全是代码：grounding、穷举执行、发布检查，以及一个带门的修复回路。最终返回给用户的那个值，不由模型提供。

Evidence · localisation证据 · 可定位性

Failures land on a named stage, mostly before anything is read失败有具体落点，而且多数在碰数据之前

Across 1,725 recorded repair events, each rejection carries the condition that fired and the stage that raised it. Most fire before a single record is read, which sets what a rejection costs: a replan, not a wrong answer someone has to catch downstream. 记录到的 1,725 次修复里，每一次拒绝都带着触发条件和抛出它的阶段。绝大多数发生在读第一条记录之前。这决定了拒绝的代价：重规划一次，而不是放出一个错误答案，等下游有人去发现。

Evidence · verified experience is enough to learn from证据 · 已验证的经验足以用来学习

Students trained only on verified traces overtake the teacher that proposed them学生只学已验证的轨迹，反超了出题的教师

A candidate program enters the training pool only if it type checks, grounds, executes, and reproduces the oracle. Nothing else is kept. Trained on that pool alone, the strongest local system reaches 85.65% on the sealed test against 69.76% for the cloud model that supplied its candidates. Removing the teacher entirely and letting the student harvest from itself holds level with supervised fine-tuning, so it is the acceptance rule carrying the signal rather than continued access to a stronger model. 一个候选程序要同时满足四条才进训练池：类型检查通过、能 grounding、能执行、结果与 oracle 一致。别的一律丢掉。只用这个池训练，最强的本地系统在封闭测试上是 85.65%，提供候选的云端模型是 69.76%。把教师撤掉、让学生自己采样，结果和监督微调持平——所以起作用的是验收规则，不是能不能继续用更强的模型。

Evidence · a fixed skill set has a measurable ceiling证据 · 固定的技能集有一个可测量的上限

Porting the language to tables measures what it cannot say换个领域，就能量出这门语言说不出什么

The same algebra transfers to WikiTableQuestions with all 17 operators unchanged plus one table-specific node, lifting an untrained baseline from 22.51% to 51.80% on the official test. A differential audit against 11,276 reference programs then locates the remaining gap in coverage rather than in the executor: translated in-coverage programs match the reference denotation in 92–93% of cases. 同一套代数搬到 WikiTableQuestions，十七个算子一个没改，只加了一个表格专用节点，就把未训练的基线从 22.51% 带到官方测试的 51.80%。再拿 11,276 条参考程序做差分审计，剩下的差距落在覆盖率上，不在执行器上：能被这门语言表达的程序，翻译结果有 92–93% 和参考外延一致。

Three findings that complicate this三个让结论复杂起来的发现

Every check passed and the answer was still wrong所有检查都过，答案依然错

A bridge question grounded, executed, and cleared all three release checks, returning 37 against an oracle of 6,962. Counting a set is structurally legal, so no implemented condition could tell that the wrong set had been counted. Verification is a release gate, not an oracle.一道桥接题过了 grounding、过了执行，三道发布检查也全过，返回 37，真值是 6,962。数一个集合在结构上完全合法，已实现的检查里没有一条能看出它数错了集合。校验是发布闸门，不是正确性判据。

The repair loop caused its own regression修复回路自己造成了退化

An earlier ungated design turned 6 correct refusals into incorrect answers. Repair now opens only after a typed, diagnosable failure, and refusals and clean empty results are terminal, so the agent cannot keep searching until it finds an answer it prefers.早期的修复没有门，把 6 个本来正确的拒答改成了错误回答。现在只有出现类型化、能诊断的失败才允许修复；拒答和干净的空结果都是终态，agent 没法一直搜到自己满意为止。

A weakly specified harness fakes a capability result说明不足的评测框架会伪造能力结论

While measuring a free-form SQL baseline, three gaps in my own harness — answer extraction, one withheld column, a missing categorical vocabulary — moved it from 38.2% to 54.4%. Until each was found, the handicap was indistinguishable from incapability.测一个自由写 SQL 的基线时，我自己评测框架里的三处毛病——答案怎么取、少给了一列、没给类别取值——把它从 38.2% 一路抬到 54.4%。在这些被找出来之前，被绑住手脚和确实不会，长得一模一样。

Where I want to take this我想把它推到哪里

Everything above holds partly because the harness is stateless by construction. Each question is a fresh session, the oracle appears only while training data is built, and no component carries anything across runs. There is nothing to contaminate. The three questions I want to work on are what remains once that assumption is dropped. 上面这些能成立，有一部分原因是这套 harness 本来就没有状态：每个问题都是新会话，oracle 只在造训练数据时出现，没有组件跨运行带东西。没有东西可以被污染。我想做的三个问题，就是这个前提去掉以后还剩什么。

1 · Localising failure across a whole agent1 · 在整个 agent 上定位失败

A failed trajectory can come from perception, grounding, a stale state assumption, the wrong retrieval, the wrong tool, a planning error, or an action that makes progress while breaking a constraint. Collapsing all of that into one scalar reward throws away most of what the interaction contained. Here the taxonomy is deterministic because the environment is closed; in an open one some checks will have to be learned. What I would keep is locality and auditability: the system should say what failed, where, and on what evidence.一条失败的轨迹，来源可能是感知、grounding、过期的状态假设、检索错了、工具选错、规划出错，也可能是某个动作推进了任务却违反了约束。把这些压成一个标量奖励，这次交互里的大部分信息就没了。这里的失败分类是确定性的，因为环境封闭；换到开放环境，有些检查只能学出来。我想保住的是局部性和可审计性：系统要说得出哪里错了、错在哪一步、凭什么这么判断。

2 · Verification on memory, not only on actions2 · 把校验施加在 memory 上，而不只是动作上

My acceptance rule is already a primitive version of this: it decides what enters the training pool, which is the only memory this system has. A long-running agent needs the same discipline on writes and retrieval — evidence that is uncertain, context-specific, or attached to a corrected decision should be revised or quarantined rather than left to influence unrelated tasks later. How does a gate that fires before execution behave when the thing being verified has a history?我的验收规则已经是这件事的雏形——它决定什么能进训练池，而训练池是这个系统唯一的记忆。长期运行的 agent 需要把同样的纪律用在写入和检索上。有些证据本身不确定，有些只在当时的上下文里成立，有些依附于一个后来被推翻的决策；它们不该原样留着，去影响以后不相关的任务。一道原本在执行前触发的闸门，当被检查的东西带着历史，会变成什么样？

3 · When should a correction become a skill3 · 一次纠正在什么时候该变成技能

The 39.6% above is what a frozen operator set costs. Keeping every correction explicit stays auditable but grows expensive; folding experience straight into weights is efficient but hard to inspect or revoke. I am interested in the lifecycle between them: what evidence should be required before a behaviour is abstracted into a skill, how a new skill is verified before it is composed with others, and how an agent notices that a skill it relied on no longer holds in a changed environment — with the executable checks and counterexamples that justified each promotion kept as an audit layer.上面那个 39.6% 就是算子清单冻住的代价。把每次纠正都留成显式记忆，可审计，但会越来越贵；直接折进权重，省事，但难查也难撤。我感兴趣的是中间这段生命周期：一个行为要拿出什么证据才能被抽象成技能，新技能在跟别的技能组合之前该怎么验证，以及 agent 怎么发现自己一直靠着的某个技能，在环境变了以后已经不成立——而每一次晋升所依据的可执行检查和反例，都要留成一层审计记录。

The same instinct earlier更早的同一种取向

Each of these grounds a model's proposal into something a machine can check: a click coordinate, a ranked page, a preference pair with a structural basis. 下面这几项做的是同一件事：把模型的提议落到机器能检查的东西上——一个点击坐标、一个排序结果、一组有结构依据的偏好对。
